selection_justification: Candidate Argon2id configuration (memory_cost=65536 KiB [64 MiB], time_cost=3, parallelism=4) measured median=69.429ms and p95=82.178ms over 20 samples. The 64 MiB memory cost provides memory-hardness defense against GPU/ASIC cracking. This latency evidence is specific to the current execution environment and is NOT claimed to be a universally optimal baseline configuration. Independent benchmarking on target deployment hardware is required prior to production deployment.
